notes.title: Grimlord v1.1.1 hotfix
notes.notes: We've resolved a critical issue where players might not receive blueprints and materials after defeating the arena boss. A hotfix has been released to address this. Upon logging in, if you've already completed the task, the blueprint, materials, and armor will be automatically reissued. If you haven't completed it, you can earn the rewards by defeating the boss again. For any other issues encountered during gameplay, please visit our community for support and feedback. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Grimlord v1.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
To All Lords of the Monastery
A month has passed since our last update. We've witnessed your fervent passion for Sand and Glory, the Arena Mode, and while the weapon enhancement system has eased overall difficulty, many still voiced challenges with boss encounters. Thus, we proudly announce this brand new adjustment to smoothen the game's difficulty curve.

Initially, we considered adding selectable difficulty levels, yet this demanded excessive balancing and testing. Thanks to your invaluable feedback, we've crafted an elegant solution: Rheala's ultimate gift, The King's Gaze amulet. Equip it to weaken bosses via ancestral blessings, or face them unassisted for the purest experience.

Simultaneously, we've reforged other amulets:

Replaced obsolete Elemental Resistance stats with Attack Bonuses

Significantly boosts spellcasting potency

Two years have flown since our Early Access launch. Through countless expansions and refinements, your voices remain our compass. Thank you for your steadfast support!

notes.title: List of Changes for Sands of Glory Update
notes.notes:
Sands of Glory Update is now live!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/8ac57be21d4b9a9b4a0d6d7b2782c0841c1c6be6.png
Lords and Ladies of the Monastery,

It’s so hard to believe that nearly six months have passed since Grimlord's launch. Through your endless support and our studios' tireless effort, we're thrilled to announce that we've reached a major milestone on our development roadmap: the Arena Mode and Arena Questline Free Expansion is now officially live!

This brand new expansion introduces a series of arena-based challenges carefully woven into each chapter's theme. We’ve added new enemies, thrilling boss fights, and rewards that expand the weapon upgrade system, making your arsenal deadlier than ever. Alongside that, you’ll find brand-new weapon components and armor sets to discover.

The Arena Questline is designed for all kinds of players. For newcomers, it's a powerful tool to grow stronger. For New Game Plus veterans, it offers a fresh game mode and more than 30 new challenges. And if you enjoy testing your builds or recording exciting battles to share, the arena is now your perfect proving ground to create your own enemy combinations and dive into the killing spree!

Back during Early Access, many of you told us you wanted sandbox-style features, and that's what inspired us to develop the Arena Mode in the first place. We made a promise officially to bring this to life. While Grimlord wasn't initially designed with a sandbox arena at its core, we quickly realized how much it could enrich the game's longevity and enjoyment.

At first, we thought this would be a quick addition, maybe a few weeks of work. But reality proved otherwise. Integrating the arena with the questline added complexity we didn’t foresee, and it took more time and effort than expected. Since launch, we've redesigned the system from the ground up and expanded it from one arena map to three. Most importantly, all of this new content is 100% FREE, NO EXTRA PAYMENT REQUIRED. We want to offer more bangs for your bucks to anyone who purchased Grimlord!

We've also listened closely to community feedback and continued improving earlier content. As a small team releasing our first game, we've faced many challenges. VR is still a gaming medium in its youth, and developing Grimlord has at times pushed us beyond our limits. But we've met those challenges with passion and dedication.

In this update, we've rebuilt the weapon physics system. Slash and pierce mechanics have been completely rewritten, offering more depth and realism. Spiked polearms can now stab from multiple directions. Spikes on shields are no longer just decorative. And with enough force, your weapon may even be embedded in an enemy's body. We wanted combat to feel more tactile, authentic, and uniquely fun.

These improvements will also benefit the upcoming MOD support, which is just around the corner. Stay tuned to our community channels for updates!

Lastly, we want to address the broader state of VR. Over the past few months, skepticism about the VR industry has been growing. Indeed, not every game is performing well, but we remain deeply confident in the future of VR gaming. We're committed to continuously optimizing Grimlord and delivering new content. Your support fuels our progress. This is a journey for the ages, and we're in it for the long haul.

To our incredible community: thank you. Especially to those who joined our tests and shared your feedback, your support and dedication helped shape Grimlord into what it is today.

We want to say a very special thank you to: Aerith, Banshee, Blaze, Chickensink, Cim, Dare, Deepestlore, DelayZe, Dino, Fox, Hiei, Ithious, Jagger, Jarv, JessikaNova, KUPOkinz, Lethalxxdose, MiaLunaria, MORK, Morkle, MythicAssassin8, NavKiro, NovaFae, OFF_TRK, Pakwei, Shenanigans303, Silverfire, Skadi, Suha04, Tarquinn2049, The CLBJ, The French Pineapple, unknownasphalt, vrBuddy, yee, ZURRR_111 for your help in testing and support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/b27a5ee0a72a9b4e7f35c8bae921e70881fa6b0f.png
New Additions
• New Maps – Added four new levels, including the 3 Arenas and the Arena Hub.
• New NPC – A quartermaster is now available early in the game. Found at the Arena Hub and accessible anytime.
• Arena Questline – A dedicated Arena questline featuring 18 unique challenges.
• Custom Battle Mode – Create your own battles in the Arena for personalized combat scenarios.
• Training Questline – Visit the Faithless to learn advanced melee techniques in a new storyline.
• Weapon Upgrade System – Use materials earned through Arena challenges to upgrade and enhance weapons.
• New Enemy Types – Bandits, Gladiators, Goblin Priests, Goblin Berserkers, Wolves
• Arena Boss Battles – Each Arena level now features its own boss fight.
• New Armor Set – The Gladiator Armor is now available.
• New action - You can kick enemies, or use headbutts.

Improvements
• Opening Cinematic – Replaced all AI-generated elements. The intro cutscene is now fully handcrafted.
• Weapon Physics Overhaul – Weapons can now pierce from multiple angles. Heavy slashes may embed into enemy bodies.
• Environmental Detail – Added more vegetation and visual variety to make environments feel more dynamic.
• Talent Reset Button – Now includes a hold-to-reset progress bar to prevent accidental resets.
• Lighting Improvements – Enhanced lighting setups in several key areas.

Balance Adjustments
• Boss Defense – Reduced defense for some bosses when hit in weak spots or during specific vulnerable states.

Weapon Balancing
• Maidenblood Blade – Piercing: 52 → 36 | Slashing: 40 → 32 | Stability: 30 → 15
• Monarch – Slashing: 45 → 48
• Royal Sword – Slashing: 40 → 35
• Broadsword – Piercing: 37 → 29
• Faithkeeper Sword Handle – Passive changed from Deeper Cuts (+12% slashing damage two-handed) → Enforce (+12% physical skill damage)
• Nomadic Warrior Armor – Movement Speed: 540 → 500

Meta Exclusive
• Blood Effects – Blood now displays properly during combat.
• Hit Detection – Increased collision thickness on certain weapons to reduce clipping caused by framerate inconsistencies.

Steam Exclusive
• DX12 Texture Fix – Resolved a bug where some textures appeared blurry under DirectX 12.

Thank you all so very much for the continued support and we hope everyone enjoys the update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/5216eae23707ebacbaa2052ff4f4a3724b97b23d.png

notes.title: Grimlord v1.0.5 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/a289b02f58c76fce88734ea0850f09f56ab90fd2.png

Dear Brave Adventurers,

It has been two months since the official launch of the game, and we are actively working to address various issues highlighted by the community. We are also steadily developing new content.

In this significant update, we addressed the frequently raised issue of lost weapons. Now, when a player's character dies, all dropped weapons will be retrieved by Pech and respawned near the resurrection point. You won't need to rummage through the monastery anymore. Please note that this feature will not activate if you use the teleport feature, to avoid a situation where a bunch of weapons rain down on you every time you arrive at a teleport point. Overall, this adjustment will greatly enhance the gameplay experience. We welcome any further suggestions and encourage you to participate in the community discussions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/5e0bfa5a9eaf335925f3d21cc3fb3b442869f823.gif

Furthermore, we have increased the frequency of physics calculations. We have also addressed the issue of weapon penetration through monsters, which Meta Quest players have reported. While it's hard to eliminate this issue for now, our testing indicates that only high-speed and short attacks may be missed. We hope these improvements will enhance the experience for Meta Quest users.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/3931cb54e6b74cd0f581c3265f28775039c91bd9.gif

In terms of future plans, we are intensifying our preparations for the arena mode, along with a storyline and quests that complement this mode. The arena will be an extension of the main storyline, featuring its own narrative threads that are still connected to the main plot. The rewards obtained from the arena will also help us explore the main storyline more effectively.

We remain dedicated to improving players' experiences and fostering an active and open community. If you have any insights about Grimlord, we invite you to join our community discussions.

To know more about the rest of the update, read through the patch notes below.

[hr][/hr]
v1.0.5 Update Highlights

 Weapon Recovery Mechanism: Weapons dropped upon a player's death near the respawn point, the navigation station.
 New Boss State - The Guardian: Players can now knock off the Guardian's helmet, allowing headshots that deal increased damage.
 UI Hint for Skipping Cutscenes: Introduced a UI prompt for players to skip cutscene animations.


Improvements

 Physics Enhancements: Improved the frequency of physical related to hands and weapons, reducing the failed swing physics.
 Collision Feedback for Enemies: Enhanced the physical collision response from certain enemies.
 Post-Processing Effects: Upgraded post-processing effects to improve visual quality (SteamVR).
 Change: The default grip point for the Dueling Sword has been adjusted.
 Change: Summoned enemies no longer drop Matter.
 Change: The Matter acquisition rate for each NG+ tier has been reduced from 50% to 20%.


Fixes

 Chapter Two Taskline: Resolved a rare issue causing interruptions in the taskline for Chapter Two.
 Translation Errors: Fixed several translation errors.
 Weapon Lock Issue: Corrected the problem where a player’s weapon would become locked in space after the character's death.

notes.title: Grimlord v1.0.4 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/01a1c9ea413415a313d592e0a2d287fd57524d1f.png

Dear Brave Adventurers,

It's been a while since the game's release, and we’ve received a lot of feedback since then. We appreciate Grimlord and the entire community as a whole, and a significant part of it has been positive. 

Thank you sincerely for your support! We are committed to ongoing optimization and content updates because this is a long-term endeavor that doesn't end with the game's launch.

We are proud to have a highly active community where players engage, explore, and share valuable suggestions. We’ve also noted various issues players have encountered. Many have expressed that spell casting is difficult to use and ineffective.

In response, we've improved the tutorial for the spell casting, and buffed the mana damage. Additionally, some new players found certain early-game enemies quite challenging, so we’ve made adjustments to make sure everyone can get through the first 2 levels in an easier way.

However, this doesn’t mean defeating enemies will be easy; you will still need to be fully engaged in the combat!

Looking ahead, we are strictly following our roadmap. Soon, you can expect the introduction of arena quests and a dedicated arena mode, along with a new enhancement system. These changes will provide new players with better progression paths and offer more enjoyment for those with multiple New Game+ runs. We are also excited to soon support modkits, which are nearly ready for use.

This will bring a whole new world to the game, and we can't wait to see the creativity players will unleash!

Now, let’s take a closer look at the changes in this patch.

[hr][/hr]
Update Highlights

 Replaced all low-quality textures with high-quality ones.
 Added sound effects for armored footsteps, weapon swings, and other object swings.
 Significantly increased damage ratio for slashing attacks to enemies' weakness.
 Overhauled the UI assets for the main menu.
 New: Redesigned the spell-casting tutorial.
 Slightly reduced the mana consumption for all spells.


Changes

 Reduced enemy armor's damage reduction from slashing attacks from 60% to 40%.
 Reduced the increase in slashing damage to enemy flesh from 150% to 120%.
 Slightly reduced the health of zombies.
 Slightly reduced the health of human enemies.
 Increased the movement speed of the Vanguard Warrior’s armor from 450 to 540.
 The damage of the Black Order Magister's skills is now correctly calculated in the New Game+ playthrough.
 The damage of the Elder Race's skills is now correctly calculated in the New Game+ playthrough.
 The damage of the Hollowed One's skills is now correctly calculated in the New Game+ playthrough.
 The damage of the Siamese's skills is now correctly calculated in the New Game+ playthrough.
 The damage of Fedelixia's skills is now correctly calculated in the New Game+ playthrough.
 The skill damage of the Goblin Hero is now correctly calculated in the New Game+ playthrough.
 Fixed the bug with the Stone Golem boss getting stuck at the lower doors


Optimization

 Optimized the player equipment slot interaction detection range.
 Optimized the attribute details when the player interacts with racks.
 Optimized the interaction sound effects for the guards.
 Optimized the action sound effects for human mercenaries.
 Optimized the action sound effects for goblin captains.
 Optimized the zombie physical collision effects.
 Optimized the action for the Stone Golem boss when grabbing large rocks.
 Optimized the enemy respawn mechanism


Fixes

 Fixed the issue of screen freezing and jittering.
 Fixed a bug that prevented the base guards from pursuing players after you attacked him.
 Fixed an issue where certain potions could not be picked up.
 Fixed a bug that prevented Fedelixia's spell from erasing and kept dealing damage to players

notes.title: Halloween 2024: A Grimlord Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/2e56a15c0601c3453c23d8a2cdd22c57a2baf2fa.png

What better time of the year than a Halloween full of updates? 🎃

Last time, we talked about the dawn of a new Grimlord Era. Now, we're switching things up - tenfold.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/0de03accd58f109725236fc721a49658e68a15d3.gif

An engine upgrade, a closed beta, an in-game Halloween event, Rhaela bringing her treats and tricks into Discord, and our participation for Steam Scream Fest 3 - all jam-packed into one spook-tastic major update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/587d41a6d64794a4e3a1bbf9788430eea26bd60e.gif

Let's have a look at what the time of shadows have brought upon us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/f5184827de642d7583ee7fb6b130d18a312c4caf.gif

[hr][/hr]
Unreal Engine 5 - A Sprint to the Future

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/69147bca125ea4359ce715ffd49bd90f032c2947.gif

We're starting off with the biggest news - Grimlord is now on Unreal Engine 5.

With the move to the latest Unreal Engine 🍬, we're bringing key technological advancements to Grimlord with the aim of significantly enhancing the player experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/b65c253c2133990f3bae909ec4fe3776b99dd981.gif

Some of the massive improvements to Grimlord brought by the move to Unreal Engine 5 include, but are not limited to:

A New Physics System - UE5's new Physics system offers more granular control over physics simulations, allowing for more customized and realistic effects. This enhances combat accuracy, world immersion, and realism, especially in VR.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/cd0152b54e72465214eb6f5f40881e93dbdbfe54.gif

Bigger Development Breathing Room - UE5's potential for development brings us better ways to manifest our vision into reality - making it possible to expand some in-game mechanics. The best example is the Talent System, which has been updated to the latest version, allowing players to level up to 30 and have full access to the complete talent tree.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/2c862059e6235d21faa9331e6b55e1ca4f0ef1ce.gif

A Truly Immersive World - UE5 allows for incredibly detailed environments without sacrificing performance. It's particularly beneficial for Grimlord as a VR game, where high-quality visuals are crucial for total immersion. It also offers significant performance improvements, especially for VR, where frame rate and latency are critical.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/b302dce3bc45d699371047378ecca5e76f52f832.gif

The move to Unreal Engine 5 is just the tip of the iceberg. Overall, this has allowed us to determine what to include on the renewed roadmap.

We'd love to hear from you about the move to Unreal Engine 5. Let us know your thoughts, feedback, suggestions, and anything else on Discord!

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Grimlord v0.4.7 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers:
   We are so excited to announce that version 0.4.7 has been integrated. In this update, we modified the weapon system. Now, when you wield two-handed weapons with both hands, your damage will be higher. With a bit more practice, you'll be able to defeat enemies more easily.
   Two weeks ago, we launched the standalone device version of Grimlord (on Quest Applab). Everything is working perfectly so far, and the standalone version will provide almost the same experience as the PC version, except for some graphics differences. We know that everyone is waiting for the second chapter. Everything is going well so far. We did some internal testing and are happy to report that several sections in the level can already be played with minimum issues. We are also preparing the AI for new enemy types and BOSS battles. Another important piece of news is that we started the production of the third chapter a few weeks ago. We will evaluate chapters 2 and 3 as a whole for the completeness of the story, maybe the two chapters will be launched at the same time and bring the story home with a memorizing climax. There is much to be considered, and we hope you, our beloved fans, will wait patiently for a little bit longer.
   While level designers and visual artists are working hard to make those levels, our engineers are also optimizing certain systems and mechanics, and we hope to continue to enhance the physical combat experience, which runs very well on standalone devices. We are also expanding and modifying the talent tree, and it is expected that new test content will be available soon.


New addition:
Boost two-handed weapons performance through a new system. Now when you hold a two-handed weapon with both hands, it will deal more damage and have increased poise break.


Fixes:

1. Correct the Cavalry Shield's name to Heater Shield.
2. The Christmas event has been closed. Players who have already obtained the luxury pouch will keep them, and any newly created characters under the same account will also receive them. This pack will be in the costume-switching scroll.
3. Players will have 5 points for all basic attributes. 
4. Change the 32 points of Vitality provided by Knight Armor to 25 points.
5. Change the 22 points of Vitality provided by Leather Armor to 15 points.
6. Change the 15 points of Strength provided by Leather Armor to 10 points.
7. Change the 21 points of Vitality provided by the Garment of Pride to 15 points.
8. Fixed the weapon disappearing issue at the death screen.

Optimizations

1. Optimized the handling of some weapons, making the grip more stable.
2. Optimized the effect of human enemies after being hit, incorporating more physical feedback.

Modified skills

1. The passive skill provided by the sword component Long Grip has been changed from Increasing slashing damage by 10% when holding with two hands to Increasing poise damage by 10% when holding with two hands.
2. Sword component Dueling sword grip adds 1 passive skill. Increasing pierce damage by 5%
3. Daggar component Wooden grip adds 1 passive skill Increase slashing damage by 5%
4. Axe component Viking ax handle adds 1 passive skill Increase slashing damage by 5%
5. Long shaft component Spear shaft of Ordeal adds 1 passive skill Increase pierce damage by 10% when holding with two hands
6. The passive skill provided by the long shaft component Iron Sheet has been changed from Increasing poise damage by 10% when holding with two hands to Increasing slashing damage by 10% when holding with two hands.
7. The passive skill of the Long shaft has been removed. (The trait is that it is long)
8. Long shaft component Wooden shaft adds 1 passive skill. Increase pierce damage by 5%.
9. Hammer component Hammer handle adds 1 passive skill. Increase poise damage by 10% when holding with two hands
10. Shield component Cavalry Shield adds 1 passive skill. Maximum blocking rate increase by 30

notes.title: Merry Christmas Special Update
notes.notes:
V0.4.6 Update Announcement

Dear Fellow Adventurers:
Merry Christmas! Thank you for your love and support for Grimlord! We have some gifts for you!
We know the long wait for the new chapter to come out requires tons of patience, but in order to have an ideal and optimized experience we have to spend more time polishing it.
As a token of our gratitude and to celebrate this holiday, we present to you a content update, which fixed certain game breaking bugs. We also made a new weapon - the crossbow. It requires some maneuvering to reload, but is very powerful and can easily pierce through enemy’s chainmail. We have also made a new necklace accessory system. You get one early on and once you put in on, you have the ability to teleport to the hub area. We will add more accessories with various functions in future updates to enrich our strategies in combat and adventure. You can find a jewelry box back in the hub area, there you can choose the necklace you want to put on. Hope you guys enjoy these new weapons and features.
We're going full steam ahead to development Grimlord. We want to make it as epic as possible and there's still a ton of new content in the making and planned out. 
Thank you for supporting us! We wish you a happy new year!

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/c9a6835a2f1e86016d80a9f39832ad5b438d6fdc.jpg
Dear Lords of the Monastery,

Halloween is upon us again, and the despicable Pumpkin Lord has returned. This time, he’s not battling us alone, this time, he was possessed by a very essential entity in Chapter 2. You can start this quest from the Exiled Mage after completing the teleportation tutorial

Defeat him! Shatter his souls! Take his belongings!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/7fd2305205168c541a90bf291d608b07b928f3a2.jpg
Note on the Pumpkin Lord, written by the Exiled Mage:
The Pumpkin Lord is on the prowl again, it’s unfortunate that I must introduce him under these circumstances.
Decades ago, back when we both studied under the supreme warlock, the Pumpkin Lord was known as Sir Sandialos of SorrowVille.
He's talented, I remembered clearly he mastered every advanced spell while the rest of us were struggling to cast a simple illumination. But he was also prejudiced, always picked on pupils from minor houses, breaking their wands and staves just because he “despise lesser instruments ”.
A shame that even in death, he refused to rest, and kept coming back with vile and mischievous intentions. Now, he's a reanimated corpse housing two spirits, one is the man I had the displeasure of knowing, the other, is a grudgeful young soul taken from this world too early and seeking to “get even” with the man in the wheelchair.
But it’s better if we resolve this Pumpkin Lord and angry spirit situation ourselves, not burdening his mind.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/d76963ac39b6c73620ffe3102e4e9c890219086a.png
In addition to the undead, human mercenaries have also joined the fight. They are more cunning and more lethal, their movements are unpredictable and their combat tactics are versatile. And each type of human enemy has a unique personality. Some are bolder and will get up in your face as soon as they see you, some are more discreet and favor long-range weapons and vantage points, and some will gang up on you or gradually surround you. Their AI will be much more complex and intricate in later versions. 

https://i.imgur.com/Ah3hIT9.gif

To reflect a bit of reality when it comes to human enemies, if you hit them in their weak points like exposed necks or gaps in helmets, they will drop dead immediately. So, practice more and master your technics if you want to one-shot them.

https://i.imgur.com/PCB38qC.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/d76963ac39b6c73620ffe3102e4e9c890219086a.png
Various mechanics and content including talent tree, new boss fights, and new regions, NPCs, and weapon parts are set to be updated in later versions!
Thank you for playing Grimlord, enjoy the carnage!

Dev Log:
New content:
1. New region: Castle Roar, is open to exploring!
2. New enemy AI: Human hostile. They will wield different weapons and combine different tactics when fighting you. 
3. New enemy type: Mercenary scouts, lightly armored archers, and bowmen.
4. New enemy type: Imperial sentry guards, heavily armored master at arms that love close-quarter combat.
5. New enemy type: Warlocks without banners, cloth, and leather armored necromancers that summon ghouls.
6. Added treasure chests where you can find weapon parts or supplies.
7. Added weapon parts that you can obtain by going through treasure chests.
8. You can use new weapon parts to craft new weapons in the forge.
9. New interactives that allow you to open gates and doors in the castle.
10. Added Character creation option.
11. You can insert names on your save files.
12. Added a climbing system that allows you to climb on ladders and bricks on walls.
13. Archery system was redone, you can craft a quiver now and equip it on your waist, pressing the trigger button to pull out arrows.
14. Added a new dismember mechanic, now you can cut off the enemy's legs.
15. Add a new frozen effect. You can crush your enemies to pieces when they are frozen.
16. Added oil pots, you can throw them to form a puddle of oil on the ground which can be ignited and burn the enemy.
17. Add a new type of weapon slot. medium weapon’s handle can now be mounted in the large weapon slot on your back or a small weapon slot on your waist.

Optimized content:
18. The restoration points of potions have been increased. The restoration points of spells and life potions carried by players have been increased from 200 to 500 points, and the restoration points of potions obtained during gameplay have been increased from 50 to 150 points.
19. Fully recover supplies (potions and arrows) when the player resurrects, teleports, and rests.
20. Rendering quality improved.
21. AI efficiency has been optimized, to enhance performance when multiple enemies appear on the screen.
22. Tweaks the UI prompt rate of weapon slots to minimize distraction during combat.
23. Hand collision tweaks.
24. Potion drinking effects tweaks so they won’t overlay.
25. Enemy weak points tweaks, now you can stab the exposed parts of an enemy to land a critical hit.
26. Fixed some collision problems on some models.
27. Fixed some collision problems during interactions.
28. Fixed problems of unnormal player movement speed.

notes.title: Grimlord Demo v0.1.9 Release
notes.notes:
Update v0.1.9

Dear fellow adventurers:
      We got tons of feedback in the past few weeks following the release of Grimlord’s demo, we were thrilled to get to know your experience with the game. And, we brought some new content for this amazing game fest, just update the game and give it a try.
      In this new patch, we added hit effects of magic spells into the game, enemies will be frozen (added in the last update), paralyzed and burnt after being hit. These effects will restrict enemies’ movement in each of their unique ways and beef up the AOE abilities of sorcerer class.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/0586e10930ae4d3c6816d1845f10e112f361ba1b.gif
now we just can't afford igoring staffs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/e698be7031f442be6098bc9191bccd439f28bc6b.gif
Other than that, we removed potion slots from the game, instead, there is a small satchel to carry your consumables. We hope to mimic the realistic experience of finding items in your bags, when putting your hand on the satchel, you will see an UI prompt, press the trigger button to cycle through your items, then you can pull out the one you wanted. When putting your item back into the satchel, simple move it to wherever you want to put in inside the satchel then release the grab button (if using the Check on mode, then you need only to press the grab button once to put your item back).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/353acafa6feafcac956c796d7720730467c68811.gif
      Since we added a satchel in the game, there will be more items coming up soon, and, to let you guys get a hands-on feeling of how new items can alter the way you play the game, we added black powder grenades.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42517748/0a38454f28a7aa2701b182a32094aa4e036f76ad.gif
You can throw them toward those filthy enemies and watch them explode into bits and pieces. Black powder grenades can be found in certain areas and enemies have a small chance of dropping them.
After this update, we will concentrate on the game’s beta version, if you are interested in our game, please add our game to your wish list or join our discord to talk about all things Grimlord, you may even get a passcode for beta test. We have high hopes for Grimlord and there will be more content coming up soon. 
      We appreciate each and every one of your comment and suggestion.
Thank you for playing our game, thank you for your support!

List of changes:

New features:
1.A satchel to hold consumables and small items.
2.Black powder grenade, cause small explosion and AOE burn damage.
3.Items found in the level will not be disposed by teleportation.
4.Added turn page option in storage (weapons and inventory).
5.Enemies will have a small chance of dropping black powder grenades.
6.Paralyze effect by lightning magic.
7.Burn effect by fire magic.
8.Frozen effect by ice magic.

List of fixes:
9.Fixed incorrect damage effect when disabled gore.
10. Fixed weird weapon slips.
11.Fixed virtual desktop link controller angle and button configuration problems.

notes.notes:
Dear adventurers,

We are excited to announce that the demo build is now alive for players to download. The demo demonstrates a early-stage version where elements could be improved or replaced. Please receive this demo version as an appetizer and an invitation to our beta tests in the future. By disclosing the developing progressions, we would love to know your feedbacks and suggestions

The goal is to make Grimlord fits the community’s preferences. We are looking forward to know our feedback. We appreciate your attention and your patience more than you ever know. We hope you enjoy the demo!

Join our discord

 - win free beta keys

2.Adjusted the index gripping configuration, making weapons easier to hold.
3.Altered the descriptions on a number of weapons.
4.Added a swapping movement when casting spells with a staff.
5.Improved enemies’ getting up animation making them no longer stuck player’s weapon.

At least two other boss fights.

New eye-drawing clothes and armor.
A climbing system.
Adding more treasure chest in different sections in the game.
Adding more move sets and special attacks

Adding more weapon skills and abilities.
